The '''University of Coruscant''', also known as the '''Coruscant University''', was a university located in the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Founded by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Fillorean]] and the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] philosopher [[Borz'Mat'oh]] in [[15,500 BBY]] as Coruscant's first university, the institution offered a wide variety of courses throughout its history and gained a reputation as a premier learning institution. However, the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the New Order's [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] policies sullied the school's reputation, and it was not until almost three decades later that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] regained control of Coruscant and the University began accepting non-[[Human/Legends|Humans]] again.

==History==
===Founding and early years===
The first formal university on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="Datacron 17">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 17: The Duinuogwuin Contention}}</ref> the University of Coruscant was founded by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Fillorean]] and the [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] philosopher [[Borz'Mat'oh]] in [[15,500 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> at the end of the conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Duinuogwuin [[Species/Legends|species]] that became known as the [[Duinuogwuin Contention]]. Originally a [[University of Coruscant main campus|single tower]] in the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]] on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Coruscant, the University expanded over the millennia to include many buildings scattered throughout the district. The original tower became largely administrative offices, student housing, and several of the original lecture halls, though the two [[Chalcedony/Legends|chalcedony]] statues of Borz'Mat'Oh and Fillorean remained. The dean of the University was addressed by the traditional title of ''[[Cadaeda]]''.<ref name="Coruscant" /> The University handed out honorary degrees to individuals who were influential in their field, such as [[Nasdra Magrody]], and the recipients of honorary degrees also received gold rings.<ref name="Children of the Jedi">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] attended Coruscant University's medical program,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[First Republic Medical Academy of Coruscant]],<ref name="Holonet" /> during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the Republic, and during his time studying [[xenopathology]] Kimble's fellow students complained that he received favorable treatment from several of his [[Gender/Legends|female]] instructors.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Almost three thousand years after the Cold War, the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Murk Lundi]] taught history at the University, specializing in little-known organizations and events that had nonetheless impacted [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, Lundi's mediocre research skills led him to delve into topics and subjects outside of his standard classics in order to save his career, and the Quermian began to research the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. His attempts to retrieve a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] on the planet [[Kodai]] were foiled by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and the professor was relieved of his position when he ultimately went insane and was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] in a mental facility.<ref name="Evil Never Dies">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> The [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] medical student [[Zan Yant]] was tutored in music by one of the professors at the University's [[Coruscant University School of Music|School of Music]] in the years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the School of Music was considered one of the premier musical institutions at the [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="MedStar" /> The University's medical departments occasionally suffered from thievery during that period, such as how the [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] medical student [[Elan Sel'Sabagno/Legends|Elan Sel'Sabagno]] abused his access to the school's medical supplies and stole them to use in the production of illegal drugs.<ref name="Elan">{{DB|character|elansleazebaggano|Sleazebaggano, Elan}}</ref>

===The Clone Wars and the Empire===
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the tensions between the Republic and the fledgling [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] began to boil over, and the students of Coruscant University became embroiled in several incidents of public unrest on the capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [["Baby Ludi" custody case|controversy]] surrounding the infant [[Aris-Del Wari|Ludi Billane]], who had been adopted by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] after the two-year-old was separated from her mother in a quake on their homeworld [[Ord Thoden]], inspired many student activists to involve themselves with the ongoing events. Several students used an automated [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] program to overload two of the University's datanet hubs early in the morning with trillions and trillions of images of Ludi, who had been named Aris-Del Wari by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and whose mother, [[Jonava Billane|Jonava]], was trying to fight for custody of her daughter. By the afternoon, the program&mdash;which had been duplicating the files exponentially and overwriting existing data on the University network&mdash;had completely filled both of the hubs with images of Ludi taken from a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report. The caption "I'd rather be with Mom than [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace]]" had been added to the images, and the [[Campus Information Office]] was unable to uncover any leads in their investigation.<ref name="Baby Ludi">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|jediwatch/13314_2.html|Baby Ludi Holos Flood UoC Datanet}}</ref>

Just under a month later, a twenty-student sociology tour group infiltrated the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] through the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|public entrance]] before unleashing several pre-programmed [[graffiti-bomb]]s that sprayed messages across the lobby such as "Baby Ludi Wants Her Mom," "Broodsnatchers," and logos of the [[People's Inquest]] movement&mdash;a public watch group that was supporting Billane in her attempts to regain custody of her daughter. As the two young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] present were unwilling to utilize their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] against the activists, the group was able to push into the Temple's Second Atrium Lobby before [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], two members of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], arrived to block their path. Koon [[Mind trick/Legends|mentally subdued]] the crowd with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] so that several Padawans could remove the students peacefully, though the event gained enough attention to warrant a HoloNet report.<ref name="Lobby">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|jediwatch/13411_1.html|Activists Deface Jedi Temple Lobby}}</ref> Less than four weeks later, public uproar over the [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] drew a large number of students from the University's [[Southern Campus]]. The [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] was forced to break up the crowds of approximately 7,000 activists around the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], with thirty-eight protesters&mdash;many of whom were University students&mdash;arrested by the building's protectors.<ref name="Senate" />

The students' protests were in vain, however, as the following weeks saw the signing of the Military Creation Act and the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning of the Clone Wars]].<ref name="EpII">{{Film|II}}</ref> By that time, the Fobosi District featured many [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] that catered to the University's staff and students, including the [[Haunch of Nerf]].<ref name="Order 66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> At the end of the Clone Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="EpIII">{{Film|III}}</ref> the Republic became the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the University of Coruscant underwent significant policy changes in the era of the New Order. The Empire passed a bylaw that forbade non-Humans from applying to the University and expelled those currently attending, and in their absence the University soon became almost entirely Human [[Gender/Legends|males]]. Many of the new students were former members of the [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]] youth brigades that had been organized by the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]], and a large number of them were washouts from the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] academies&mdash;something that caused the University's reputation to suffer as most of its students pursued careers in the Imperial government. While other premier universities mocked the school as a "bureaucrat factory," the University's students damaged the school's reputation further by creating a climate of bullying and [[Humanocentrism]] that thrived over the next two decades.<ref name="Coruscant" />

Around [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] female [[Bria Tharen]] decided to study [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeology]] and ancient art at the University after completing her undergraduate education at the age of seventeen, though her exposure to the religion known as the [[Cult of The One and The All]] derailed her studies.<ref name="NewChar">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> Sometime during the period of Imperial rule, the University's [[Vice-Chancellor]] [[Zokor Polpot]] and the current [[Chancellor (University of Coruscant)|Chancellor]] were among those University officials visited the planet [[Woostri/Legends|Woostri]], and Polpot attempted to discredit his boss with a prank involving the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]]. Polpot replaced the crocodile-like head of 8t88, the [[Tiss'sharl/Legends|Tiss'sharl]] administrative droid in charge of managing Woostri's famous [[Woostri HoloScan Database|HoloScan Database]], with the smaller head of a [[JMM assassin droid|JMM series droid]], and the episode resulted in the Chancellor's resignation and Polpot's ascension to the post. However, 8t88 went on to become an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] with a bitter resentment of Humans, and he eventually [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Polpot while the Chancellor was visiting the planet [[Mawan/Legends|Mawan]] sometime before [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].<ref name="Kyle" />

===The New Republic===
When the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] the galactic capital<ref name="X-wing">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the University immediately began to accept students of all [[Species/Legends|species]], though resentment among non-Humans remained high in the years that followed as the University's Imperial reputation lingered.<ref name="Coruscant" /> By [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]], the University's [[Diplomatic Archives]] were open to the public, and it included material on figures such as [[Gaeriel Captison]], a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="Assault at Selonia">''[[Assault at Selonia]]''</ref> Students of certain species, such as [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanens]], were shunned and feared by their fellow students and even faculty on account of their fearsome appearance, though such reactions were not always exclusive to the University. Around that time, the [[Coruscant University Press]] published scholarly articles and reports by notable scientists.<ref name="Essential Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

By [[30 ABY/Legends|30 ABY]], the University had once again regained its reputation as a premier institute of learning, and it regularly dispatched research expeditions in a wide variety of fields. A group of zoologists from the University undertook an expedition to the planet [[Kowak/Legends|Kowak]], the homeworld of the [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]], though the monkey-lizards sabotaged or stole most of the researchers' equipment so that the group was forced to abandon further attempts at studying them. Under the New Republic, a panel of multicultural scientists from the University of Coruscant was in charge of the formal designation of [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]], and they issued their rulings on different species only after a research team approved by the government had conducted an extensive field study. Significant findings that could affect a species' designation were also brought before the panel.<ref name="Essential Alien" />

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] rounded up many Corellians on Coruscant, including a large number of students and professors at the University. The University greatly resented the Guard's actions, and various members of the school were more than willing to aid GAG [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Lon Shevu]] when he allied with the Jedi in order to bring down the Guard's leader and Co-[[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. From his contacts at the University, Shevu was able to acquire a shuttle belonging to the University's geological survey team, and he and [[Ben Skywalker]] successfully masqueraded as a geological professor and student on a survey to the planet [[Kavan]].<ref name="Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>
